# Visualization 1 

```{r}
df <- read.csv("data/BirthandEducation.csv")

df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Year))

df_clean <- df %>%
  rename(
    Year = Year,
    EducationLevel = Mother.s.Education,
    Births = Births
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Births))

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Number of Births by Mother's Education Level (U.S.)"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("yearRange", 
                  "Select Year Range:", 
                  min = 2007, 
                  max = 2023,
                  value = c(2007, 2023),
                  step = 1,
                  sep = ""),
      
      checkboxGroupInput("eduLevels", 
                         "Select Education Level(s):",
                         choices = unique(df_clean$EducationLevel) %>% setdiff(c("trace 0", "Excluded")),
                         selected = unique(df_clean$EducationLevel) %>% setdiff(c("trace 0", "Excluded")))
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("birthPlot", width = "150%", height = "600px"),
      br(),  # space between plot and table
      DTOutput("summaryTable")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  filteredData <- reactive({
    df_clean %>%
      filter(
        Year >= input$yearRange[1],
        Year <= input$yearRange[2],
        EducationLevel %in% input$eduLevels
      )
  })
  
  output$birthPlot <- renderPlotly({
    p <- ggplot(filteredData(), aes(x = Year, y = Births, color = EducationLevel, group = EducationLevel)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      labs(
        x = "Year",
        y = "Number of Births",
        color = "Education Level",
        title = "Number of Births by Mother's Education Level",
        subtitle = "Data from 2007 to 2023",
        caption = "Source: BirthandEducation.csv"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
      )
    
    ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y", "color"))
  })
  
  output$summaryTable <- renderDT({
    filteredData() %>%
      group_by(EducationLevel) %>%
      summarise(TotalBirths = sum(Births, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      arrange(desc(TotalBirths)) %>%
      datatable(
        rownames = FALSE,
        options = list(
          pageLength = 10,
          lengthChange = FALSE,
          searching = TRUE,
          ordering = TRUE
        ),
        colnames = c("Education Level", "Total Births")
      )
  })
}
```

# Visualization 2

```{r, eval=TRUE}
# read and clean data
data <- readr::read_csv("data/mergedWorldDataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(avgChildbearingAge),
         !is.na(womenEmpowermentIndex),
         !is.na(marriageRate)) |>
  select(Year, avgChildbearingAge, womenEmpowermentIndex, marriageRate)


# create layout with slider for year, and choices for y-axis metrics
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Women's Empowerment Data Over Time (U.S.)"),
  
  tags$div(
    style = "margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.4;",
    tags$br(),
    tags$p(
      "This dashboard explores trends in key social indicators for women in the United States, 
      including average childbearing age and marriage rate, alongside the Women's Empowerment Index. 
      It aims to explore the question: How have changes in women’s empowerment in the U.S. from 1993 
      to 2020 affected the way that women are assuming traditional family roles?"
    ),
    tags$br(),
    tags$p(
      tags$b("Women's Empowerment Index:"), 
      " A composite index ranging from 0 to 1, where higher values indicate greater empowerment 
      through factors such as education, political participation, and economic inclusion."
    )
  ),
  tags$br(),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput(
        "yearRange", "Select Year Range",
        min(data$Year), max(data$Year),
        value = c(min(data$Year), max(data$Year)),
        step = 1, sep = ""
      ),
      selectInput(
        "yMetric", "Select Y-Axis Metric:",
        choices = c(
          "Average Childbearing Age" = "avgChildbearingAge",
          "Marriage Rate" = "marriageRate"
        ),
        selected = "avgChildbearingAge"
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("barLinePlot", height = "520px")
    )
  )
)

# server that displays graph
server <- function(input, output) {

  output$barLinePlot <- renderPlotly({
    filtered_data <- data |>
      filter(Year >= input$yearRange[1], Year <= input$yearRange[2]) |>
      mutate(
        selectedMetric = .data[[input$yMetric]],
        emp = womenEmpowermentIndex,
        var_label = ifelse(
          input$yMetric == "avgChildbearingAge",
          "Average Childbearing Age (years)",
          "Marriage Rate (per 1,000)"
        ),
        hover_text = paste0(
          "Year: ", Year,
          "<br>", var_label, ": ", round(selectedMetric, 2),
          "<br>Women's Empowerment Index: ", round(emp, 2)
        )
      )

    p <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Year)) +
      geom_col(aes(y = selectedMetric, fill = emp, text = hover_text), width = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "C", end = 0.9, direction = 1,
        name = "Empowerment Index"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(filtered_data$Year), max(filtered_data$Year), 5)) +
      labs(
        x = "Year",
        y = ifelse(
          input$yMetric == "avgChildbearingAge",
          "Average Childbearing Age (years)",
          "Marriage Rate (per 1,000)"
        ),
        title = "Selected Metric vs. Women's Empowerment Over Time"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
      )

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
      layout(hoverlabel = list(align = "left"))
  })
}
```

# Visualization 3

```{r}
data = read_csv("data/mergedWorldDataset.csv")

mergedWorld = data[18:87,] %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

# Compute 5-year ticks STYLE IMPROVEMENT
year_range <- range(mergedWorld$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_min <- floor(year_range[1] / 5) * 5
year_max <- ceiling(year_range[2] / 5) * 5
year_breaks <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 5)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("GDP vs Birthrates Comparison"),
  fluidRow(
    column(6, plotOutput("plot1", brush = brushOpts(id = "sharedBrush", resetOnNew = FALSE))),
    column(6, plotOutput("plot2", brush = brushOpts(id = "sharedBrush", resetOnNew = FALSE)))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  selectedYears <- reactiveVal(numeric(0))

  observeEvent(input$sharedBrush, {
    brushed <- brushedPoints(mergedWorld, input$sharedBrush, xvar = "Year", yvar = NULL)
    selectedYears(brushed$Year)
  })

  # A nicer base theme to reuse
  nice_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.text = element_text(margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2))
    )

  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    highlightYears <- selectedYears()
    mergedWorld %>%
      mutate(highlight = Year %in% highlightYears) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = avgBirthWomen)) +
      geom_point(aes(alpha = highlight, size = highlight)) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.5), guide = "none") +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 3, "FALSE" = 1), guide = "none") +
      # Denser axes
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 10), labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
      labs(title = "Birth Rates Over Time", y = "Average births per woman", x = "Year") +
      nice_theme
  })

  output$plot2 <- renderPlot({
    highlightYears <- selectedYears()
    mergedWorld %>%
      mutate(highlight = Year %in% highlightYears) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = gpdCapita)) +
      geom_point(aes(alpha = highlight, size = highlight)) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.3), guide = "none") +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 3, "FALSE" = 1), guide = "none") +
      # Denser axes
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 10), labels = label_comma()) +
      labs(title = "GDP Per Capita Over Time", y = "GDP per Capita", x = "Year") +
      nice_theme
  })
}

```

```{r}
# Labels for nice facet titles
nice_labels <- c(
  avgBirthWomen = "Births per Woman",
  avgChildbearingAge = "Average Childbearing Age",
  marriageRate = "Marriage Rate",
  democracyIndex = "Democracy Index"
)

# Master events table
events_master <- tibble(
  key   = c("pill", "epa", "roe", "dobbs"),
  label = c("Pill approval", "Equal Pay Act", "Roe v. Wade", "Dobbs"),
  year  = c(1960, 1963, 1973, 2022)
)
```

## Plotting Functions

* Plot 1
```{r}
# plot of multiple graphs w/variables (by faceting)
make_small_multiples <- function(df, demo_var, events = NULL) {
  keep_cols <- c("Year", "avgBirthWomen", "democracyIndex", demo_var)
  
  plot_df <- df %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "series", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(series = factor(series, 
                           levels = keep_cols[-1],
                           labels = unname(nice_labels[keep_cols[-1]]))) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(Year, value)) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(~ series, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = "Trends in Birth Rates, Demographics, and Democracy Over Time",
      x = "Year",
      y = ""
      ) +
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title   = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    )
  
if (!is.null(events) && nrow(events) > 0) {

  facet_ranges <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(series) %>%
    summarise(
      ymin = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      ymax = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      y0   = ymin + 0.10 * (ymax - ymin),
      step = 0.08 * (ymax - ymin)
    )

  # bottom facet label (as character)
  bottom_lab_chr <- tail(levels(plot_df$series), 1)

  # dashed lines in ALL facets
  ev_lines <- crossing(
    events %>% select(year, label),
    facet_ranges %>% select(series)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      # ensure series factor levels match the plotting data
      series = factor(series, levels = levels(plot_df$series))
    )

  # labels ONLY in the bottom facet
  k  <- 3
  br <- facet_ranges %>% filter(as.character(series) == bottom_lab_chr)

  ev_labels <- events %>%
    mutate(
      ord = row_number(),
      lvl = (ord - 1) %% k,
      y   = br$y0 + lvl * br$step,
      x   = year - 1.1,
      # force series to be the same factor/levels as plot_df$series
      series = factor(bottom_lab_chr, levels = levels(plot_df$series))
    )

  event_levels  <- events_master$label
  event_palette <- c(
    "Pill approval" = "blue",
    "Equal Pay Act" = "purple",
    "Roe v. Wade"   = "darkgreen",
    "Dobbs"         = "red"
  )

  # add historical event lines onto the graph
  p <- p +
    geom_vline(
      data = ev_lines,
      aes(xintercept = year, color = label),
      linetype = 3, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = ev_labels,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = paste0(label, " (", year, ")"), color = label),
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = event_palette,
                       limits = event_levels,
                       breaks = event_levels,
                       drop   = FALSE) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) + 
    labs(
      title = "Trends in Birth Rates, Demographics, and Democracy Over Time",
      x = "Year",
      y = ""
      ) +
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title   = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      )
  }
  p
}

```

* Plot 2
```{r}
# single graph of trends with variables 
make_index_plot <- function(df, demo_var, base_year = 1980, events = NULL) {
  keep_cols <- c("Year", "avgBirthWomen", "democracyIndex", demo_var)

  # long frame
  long <- df %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "series_raw", values_to = "value") %>%
    drop_na(Year)

  # choose a safe baseline per series:
  # - use the requested base_year if it exists and isn't NA
  # - otherwise use the first available non-NA year within the filtered data
  base_tbl <- long %>%
    group_by(series_raw) %>%
    summarize(
      base_year_eff = if (base_year %in% Year && any(!is.na(value[Year == base_year])))
                        base_year
                      else
                        min(Year[!is.na(value)], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  long2 <- long %>%
    left_join(base_tbl, by = "series_raw") %>%
    group_by(series_raw) %>%
    mutate(
      base_val = value[match(first(base_year_eff), Year)],
      # if still NA (very edge case), fall back to first non-NA value
      base_val = ifelse(is.na(base_val), first(value[!is.na(value)]), base_val),
      index = 100 * value / base_val
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    drop_na(index)

  # labels
  labels_vec <- nice_labels[names(nice_labels) %in% setdiff(keep_cols, "Year")]
  long2 <- long2 %>%
    mutate(series = factor(series_raw,
                           levels = names(labels_vec),
                           labels = unname(labels_vec)))

  # plot
  p <- ggplot(long2, aes(Year, index, color = series)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = 2, col = "red") +
    geom_label(
    aes(
      x = min(long2$Year, na.rm = TRUE) + 5,  # place near left edge
      y = 100,
      label = "Base Line = 100"
    ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = -0.5,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 4,
      color = "black",        # text color
      fill = "grey90",         # background color
      label.size = 0.3,           # border thickness
      label.r = unit(0.15, "lines") # corner radius
     ) + 
    labs( 
        title = paste0("Relative Change in Democracy Index and Demographic Indicators Since ", base_year), 
        x = "Year",
        y = "Index"
        ) + 
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title   = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title   = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text    = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
      )

  # --- events: draw ONCE (not per series), stepped and to the left ---
  if (!is.null(events) && nrow(events) > 0) {
    r   <- range(long2$index, na.rm = TRUE)
    y0  <- r[1] + 0.10 * diff(r)   # baseline height
    step <- 0.08 * diff(r)         # step between labels
    k    <- 3                      # number of levels to cycle through

    ev <- events %>%
      mutate(
        ord = row_number(),
        lvl = (ord - 1) %% k,
        y   = y0 + lvl * step,
        x   = year - 1.1              # put text to the LEFT of the line
      )
    
    # Add historical event lines onto the graph
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(
        data = ev, aes(xintercept = year),
        linetype = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      # draw text only at the bottom facet 
      geom_text(
        data = ev, aes(x = x, y = y, label = paste0(label, " (", year, ")")),
        hjust = 1, 
        vjust = 1, 
        size = 4,
        fontface = "bold",
        inherit.aes = FALSE, 
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +
      labs( 
        title = paste0("Relative Change in Democracy Index and Demographic Indicators Since ", base_year), 
        x = "Year",
        y = "Index"
        ) + 
      theme_bw() + 
      theme(
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title   = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title   = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text    = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
      )
  }
  p
}

```

## UI & Server 

```{r}
# UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Democracy Index in Context: Birth, Marriage, and Age Trends"),
  theme = shinytheme("flatly"),

  tags$head(
  tags$style(HTML("
    .guide-box{
      border:1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; margin-top:8px;
      box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
    }
    .guide-box summary{
      cursor:pointer; padding:10px 12px; font-weight:600; font-size:16px; list-style:none;
    }
    .guide-box summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display:none; }
    .guide-box summary::after{ content:'▸'; float:right; transition:transform .15s ease; color:#6b7280; }
    .guide-box[open] summary::after{ content:'▾'; }
    .guide-box .body{ padding:8px 12px 12px; }
    "))
  ),
  
  fluidRow(
    column(
      width = 3,
      wellPanel(
        sliderInput(
          "years", "Select Years",
          min = min(data_vars$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
          max = max(data_vars$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
          value = c(min(data_vars$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
                    max(data_vars$Year, na.rm = TRUE)),
          sep = "",
          ticks = FALSE
        ),

        selectInput(
          "demo_var", "Pick a Demographic Variable",
          choices = c("Average Childbearing Age" = "avgChildbearingAge",
                      "Marriage Rate"            = "marriageRate"),
          multiple = TRUE
        ),

        radioButtons(
          "view_mode", "Compare as",
          choices = c("Separate Panels" = "multiples",
                      "Relative Change" = "indexed"),
          selected = "multiples"
        ),
        
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.view_mode == 'multiples'",
          tags$details(class = "guide-box",
            tags$summary("Y-axis guide (units)"),
            div(class = "body", HTML("
              <ul style='padding-left:16px;margin:0'>
                <li><b>Births per Woman</b>: children per woman.</li>
                <li><b>Democracy Index</b>: 0–1 index (higher = more democratic).</li>
                <li><b>Average Childbearing Age</b>: years.</li>
                <li><b>Marriage Rate</b>: marriages per 1,000 people per year.</li>
              </ul>
            "))
          )),
        
        
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.view_mode == 'indexed'",
          numericInput(
            "base_year", "Base year for Relative Change since",
            value = 1980, min = 1933, max = 2024, step = 1
          ),
          helpText("In the Relative Change view, all variables are rescaled 
                   so their value in the selected base year equals 100. 
                   This makes it easy to compare percentage changes over 
                   time, even when the variables have different units or scales."),
          tags$hr(),
          tags$h4("Interpretation"),
          helpText("Values above the 100 line indicate an increase relative to 
                   the base year, while values below indicate a decrease. 
                   For example, an index of 120 means the value is 20% higher 
                   than in the base year, whereas an index of 80 means it is 20% lower")
          
        ),

        tags$hr(),
        checkboxGroupInput(
          "events_to_show", "Select Historical events",
          choices  = setNames(events_master$key, events_master$label),
          selected = NULL
        ),
        actionButton("select_all_events", "Select All"),
      )
    ),

    column(
      width = 9,
      plotOutput("viz_main", height = "750px")
    )
  )
)

# Server 
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  selection <- reactive({
    data_vars %>%
      filter(Year >= input$years[1], Year <= input$years[2])
  })
  
  chosen_events <- reactive({
  if (is.null(input$events_to_show) || length(input$events_to_show) == 0) {
    return(tibble(year = numeric(0), label = character(0)))
  }
  events_master %>%
    filter(key %in% input$events_to_show) %>%
    select(year, label)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$select_all_events, {
  updateCheckboxGroupInput(
    session,
    "events_to_show",
    selected = events_master$key
    )
  })
  
  output$viz_main <- renderPlot({
    if (input$view_mode == "multiples") {
      make_small_multiples(selection(), input$demo_var, events = chosen_events())
    } else {
      make_index_plot(selection(), input$demo_var,
                      base_year = input$base_year,
                      events = chosen_events())
    }
  })
}
```
